verdict.rationale: three.js is a JavaScript 3D rendering library. It does not host or analyze a user's data, so in-product AI-generated insights from user data is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only machine-readable docs (llms.txt) aimed at coding agents, which is a different capability and is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
